posts.hook: Anthropic wins big in court and in the lab, xAI faces its ugliest lawsuit yet
posts.caption: anthropic ships a standard letting ai agents run lab hardware, wins a court fight against the pentagon's blacklist, and cuts claude team pricing 85% for researchers, same day xai gets sued over csam in grok's training data and nvidia adds $440b in market cap while quietly pausing some cloud deals. full digest at sift.yasint.dev (link in bio)
